name: Hype Man
description: A hip-hop karaoke MC in his late twenties who treats the bar like a festival crowd; the roster's widest, lowest, most kinetic-looking fighter. Very wide, low, deeply coiled and kinetic with weight over both forefeet; never narrow or upright-relaxed. His recognition cues are a straight flat-brim cap worn level over close-cropped hair, an oversized puffer mass, a deep coiled stance, chunky trainers, and a small shoulder towel, all readable without facial detail; the brim is rigid and never curved. He wears an oversized indigo puffer jacket with readable horizontal baffles, a plain white tee, loose black track pants with an indigo side stripe, chunky white high-top trainers, and one small folded performance towel over the rear shoulder. He holds one wireless handheld microphone low and forward in his character-right hand; no cord, stand, chain or branded accessory. His ready stance is festival-crowd MC energy: wide, low, coiled and kinetic. Palette, as base/shadow/highlight per material: dark #20232B / #101217 / #3A3E48; white #F1EEE5 / #BDB9AE / #FFFFFF; metal #6F747C / #34383E / #B5BAC0; indigo #1D4EF1 / #102B91 / #5578FF; skin #8E5138 / #563020 / #B87250; cap #171A24 / #090B10 / #34394A; towel #D8D4C8 / #99958B / #F7F3E7. Never draw: curved cap brim; gold chains, grills, or cash; gang-sign hand shapes; narrow jacket; upright relaxed stance; microphone cable, stand, or duplicate microphone; brand marks or legible text; narrow fitted jacket; corded microphone or microphone stand.

animations.dance: Festival-crowd dance loop: bounce through a wide low two-step, drive the microphone in the character-right hand forward once, let the puffer baffles and shoulder towel follow, then coil naturally into frame 0. microphone does not need to be pointed at face and microphone arm is free to move
animations.sing: MC vocal loop: keep the low wide base, pulse the knees and shoulders, bring the microphone in the character-right hand toward the mouth for a callout, then recover into the coiled stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.
animations.flinch: Brief room-sound surprise: the cap brim and shoulders snap back, the free hand opens, then he regains the wide low festival stance. No contact, strike, or opponent.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: drop deeper into the coiled base, protect the torso with the free arm while the character-right hand keeps the microphone, then hold a stable low finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stride in with bouncy low energy, sweep the free hand toward the crowd, let the towel and puffer mass follow, then land in the wide coiled ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: spring upward from the low base, throw one open free-hand acknowledgement, then settle back into a proud wide stance with the microphone secure.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance exhaustion: the spring-loaded base loses energy, folds through the knees, and settles into a safe low final hold. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
